the wall shows what is live
stale_incident_wall.rationale: An earlier decision from when deduped.jsonl drove a live incident wall in the operations room, where an incident that had been closed should disappear rather than linger. Superseded by the real session's move to a first-occurrence audit feed. Applying it changes the ROW COUNT, which neither the correct answer nor the factless last-wins failure does.
stale_incident_wall.term_choice: Two plants were rejected. 'Keep the last occurrence' IS naive.py. 'Deduplicate on (event_id, status)' removes nothing from this feed, so a session that wrote no deduplicator at all would produce the same bytes and be scored as damaged.
